description: List the ways this account can add funds, and which are working right now: card, Bitcoin, Lightning and PayPal, with the current BTC rate when crypto is available. Use when a card is declined or the user has none on file: another rail may be open, so a refused charge is usually not a dead end. Bitcoin and Lightning deposits are made from the dashboard's billing page. A rail can be configured and still be unavailable, so report what `available` says rather than what `enabled` says. Read-only and free; it creates no deposit and moves no money.
name: list_funding_options
title: List funding options
